message:
Blog post slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. It normalizes the title to NFD (splitting each accented letter into a base letter and a combining mark), strips the combining marks, and then calls the vendored slugify. I didn't edit `vendor/slugify`, because its header and `vendor/README.md` say not to edit vendored code by hand.

The shop has the same bug: `src/shop/product-url.js` calls the same vendored slugify directly, so product names with accents still lose letters. I left it alone because the task was scoped to blog posts. If you want it fixed too, it's the same two-line change there, and it could share a helper.
